property_summary: After any user deposits amount>0 and withdrawAll completes, the contract must hold zero Ether (full withdrawal exactly once, no double withdrawal via reentrancy); the buggy version reverts the whole withdrawal when the attacker reenters during the external call (state not yet zeroed), leaving address(c).balance equal to the deposit.
change_summary: Move the external call before the balance and credit state updates, reintroducing a reentrancy window where state has not yet been updated when receive() executes.
